subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Grade 10 English Language Arts: English 10
overview: Grade 10 English Language Arts immerses students in collegiate literary analysis, rhetorical critique of historical documents, research synthesis, and sophisticated composition.
competencies: Evaluate complex themes, character motivations, and literary craft in seminal literary works.
Analyze rhetorical devices, persuasive arguments, and philosophical premises in foundational texts.
Compose well-substantiated research papers and argumentative essays adhering to academic citations.
Engage in sophisticated scholarly seminar discourse, defending evidence-based conclusions.

modules.title: World Literature, Cultural Perspectives & Moral Dilemmas
modules.description: Analyzing seminal world literary works, contrasting cultural worldviews, and examining complex character choices under societal pressure.

topics.title: Cultural Worldviews in World Literature
topics.description: Analyzing literature from diverse global traditions, exploring universal themes of identity, honor, and colonial resistance.

topics.title: Complex Character Development & Moral Dilemmas
topics.description: Tracing dynamic characters wrestling with internal ethical conflicts and conflicting familial duties.

modules.title: Rhetorical Critique & Seminal World Documents
modules.description: Evaluating rhetorical appeals, ethical arguments, and philosophical declarations on human rights and social justice.

topics.title: Rhetoric in Philosophical Treatises and Speeches
topics.description: Analyzing how global leaders and philosophers employ inductive and deductive reasoning to persuade.

topics.title: Delineating Competing Arguments and Fallacies
topics.description: Identifying logical flaws, false dilemmas, and emotional appeals across contrasting persuasive essays.

modules.title: Synthesis Essay Writing & Cross-Textual Research
modules.description: Writing rigorous synthesis papers integrating literary analysis with historical research, adhering to formal MLA citation.

topics.title: Comparative Literary and Cultural Analysis
topics.description: Composing analytical essays comparing how different authors treat the same subject matter or theme.

topics.title: Research Synthesis and Argumentative Defense
topics.description: Synthesizing evidence from primary documents, scholarly journals, and digital archives in support of an original thesis.
